title: RAFT: A Real-World Few-Shot Text Classification Benchmark
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (RAFT) that includes several datasets requiring ethical or moral judgments for classification. These are not merely discussed in a brief ethics section but form part of the core evaluation. Specific datasets include 'NeurIPS impact statement risks' (identifying harmful applications), 'TweetEval Hate' (detecting hate speech), and 'Terms of Service' (finding potentially unfair clauses).
